description: This file contains utility functions for handling annotations and metadata in Kubernetes resource YAML nodes, including copying, validating, and sorting annotations, especially internal and deprecated annotations.

methods.name: GetFileAnnotations
methods.description: Retrieves the file path and index annotations from a YAML node.

methods.name: GetIdAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves the ID annotation from a YAML node.

methods.name: CopyLegacyAnnotations
methods.description: Copies legacy annotations to current annotations on a YAML node.

methods.name: ErrorIfMissingAnnotation
methods.description: Validates that specified annotations are present on given nodes.

methods.name: CreatePathAnnotationValue
methods.description: Creates a default path annotation value based on directory and resource metadata.

methods.name: DefaultPathAndIndexAnnotation
methods.description: Sets default path and index annotations on nodes missing them.

methods.name: DefaultPathAnnotation
methods.description: Sets default path annotation on nodes missing it.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Applies a function to each node in a list, returning the transformed nodes.

methods.name: MapMeta
methods.description: Applies a function to each node with its metadata.

methods.name: SortNodes
methods.description: Sorts nodes based on path and index annotations.

methods.name: CopyInternalAnnotations
methods.description: Copies internal annotations from one node to another, excluding specified keys.

methods.name: ConfirmInternalAnnotationUnchanged
methods.description: Checks if internal annotations are unchanged between two nodes.

methods.name: GetInternalAnnotations
methods.description: Retrieves internal annotations from a node.
